messages.content: Great model btw (no highway in this ride) 🤓

To me, this is a fault of whoever is in charge of marking the lane on the road. I had to report an issue like this not long ago and they went back and painted arrows leading up to a lane turning into a right-turn-only lane.
if it's a road you travel often, you should report it to either the city or state depending on whoever's responsible for maintaining it
at least in the first example, didn't get through the rest
Just looking at the video and the satellite map though, there's no arrow in the center of the lane to indicate it's going to become a left-turn-only lane though
No road signs either, seems like whoever is responsible for marking the road just missed putting the arrows down is my guess.
Thats Denver for ya
It's pretty common around here now that I think of it
I'll show you the instance I reported and you'll see why I was adament about reporting it lol one sec

https://maps.app.goo.gl/Zow8rqXpAFcjrEbN6
Here's the google maps location if you wanna take a look
these two highway lanes (55 mph) have nothing about the right lane ending or turning into a right-turn-only
Yeah, that goes from a 2 lane to a one lane w/ a right turn with no warning, lol
one night on FSD my Tesla was in the right hand land and never bothered merging left while doing 60 mph
Scary
yeah, fun times 😄
I told the state in like December/January after it happened and by March they painted arrows in the lane
I think it's gonna take more instances of people like us reporting that stuff in order for FSD and Comma's driving models to understand what's going on
especially as we have turn desires
if you don't have a turn signal on, it shouldn't be putting you in a turning lane

looking at the surrounding area, they have plenty of lane markers for around the interstate (overpass and exit) but nothing outside of that. Must be one way to cut a budget or something. Tell them your marijuana taxes can surely pay for some arrows to be painted.
I gotta find the contact information for them. I use to be able to make a phone call in Alaska and they would be there the next week fixing the issues.
this also looks incredibly frustrating. The cyclists should be forced to get over in that right lane when possible rather than riding in the middle of the road

This model has one of the best lane centering/ position I have ever experience. Even during curves, it maintain close to center. 

However, turns are extremely notchy above 40 mphs. Instead of a smooth curve, it is basically trying to do a curve with multiple straight lines. Even when driving straight, it would jerk the steering wheel left 2 degrees then right 2 degrees throughout the drive.
Ha, I knew that looked familiar. Greetings fellow Coloradoan! The DTC is hard to drive through sometimes 😁
Are you still running manual torque values? Have you tried lowering your friction? (Outside of some opendbc edits) I have mine set to 3.00 and 0.01.
It’s especially hard for the driving models
I just let the self tune do it's thing. But it was still notchy after 60 miles so I just called it a day and switched back to cool gwm.
Is this model still only on dev?
For the time being yes
Seems like it's pretty positive feedback so far. I've been happy with CGWM but I'll try it out
This model seems great on the highway, but seemed to do poorly on local roads and tight turns. It wasn't able to make turns without steering warnings that it could do just fine before.
i like this model in EU

Model is pretty meh for me in a 2020 sierra. Too little torque on turns and lane changes. All lane changes in the highway require intervention or it will cross the lane marker of the NEXT lane. Lane centering is better but still pretty bad compared to laneful.

I also noticed the "notchy" steering but didn't really feel it. Just looked weird.

Sucks I gotta roll wag back to get laneful blue diamond back 😂 nothing seems to touch it for lane centering which is all I care about while towing a trailer. Every laneless model will throw the trailer into the next lane or at least put it on the lane lines.

Perhaps the extra width of a truck and trailer require better lane centering compared to cars but I've tried every laneless model recently and they're all just unable to do an acceptable job
